sentences.en: He thought of growing a beard but gave that up.
sentences.zh: 他考虑留胡子但放弃了。

sentences.en: Mommy, why don't I have an uncle with a beard?
sentences.zh: 妈妈，为什么我没有留胡子的叔叔？

sentences.en: Would you like to see your husband grow a beard?
sentences.zh: 你想看看你丈夫长出胡子吗？

senses.zh: （下巴上的）胡须；颌毛；（非正式）男同性恋者的名义女伴；替身
对抗或反对（有权势者）；抓……的胡须；提供胡须
